title: AI Glass Scan | Turn Customer Emails into Priced Glass Orders | Coglass
description: Coglass reads the glass sizes out of a customer's email or message, matches them to your products and prices, and adds them to a new or existing order for you to check.
lead: A customer emails "two panes 1200 x 900 and one 600 x 400, toughened". Press Scan and Coglass reads the sizes, matches each pane to a product in your catalogue at your price, and shows you the lines to check before they go on the order. No retyping.
steps_h2: From an enquiry to a priced order in a few clicks
steps_sub: The scan works on the message text in your Coglass inbox and on the messages kept against a job.
steps: A customer email lands in the Coglass inbox, or a message arrives on a job from the chat on your quote or tracking page.
Press Scan. The AI picks out each pane — quantity, width, height and the type of glass described.
Each pane is matched to a product in your catalogue and shown with its selling price. Anything it can't match waits for you to pick the product.
Create a new order from the message, or add the lines to one you already have. Several jobs in one message can be grouped separately.
inc_h2: Built for the way glass enquiries arrive
inc_sub: Plain-English emails with sizes in any order — the scan does the reading, you stay in charge of what goes on the job.
included: Reads the message text
Quantities, widths, heights and glass descriptions picked out of the email or message text.
Matched to your catalogue
Each pane is matched to one of your own products, priced from your catalogue.
You check before it's added
Nothing goes on an order until you've looked at the lines; unmatched panes wait for you.
New or existing order
Start a new order from the message, or add the panes to a job you already have.
More than one job in a message
When a message describes panes for different places, they are grouped so you can keep them apart.
Personal details stripped
Email addresses, phone numbers and postcodes are removed from the text before it is sent to the AI.
Email inbox
Works on emails in your connected Gmail, Outlook or other mailbox.
Messages on the job
Also works on customer messages kept against an order, like the chat on your quote and tracking pages.
WhatsApp and Messenger — coming soon
Scanning WhatsApp and Messenger enquiries switches on with those channels, once Meta has approved them.
On every plan
AI glass scans are included on every plan.
cta_p: Book a demo and we will scan one of your own enquiries — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
